Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.model.player

Class Machine

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.model.player.Player
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.model.player.Machine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Machine extends Player implements Serializable
Represents the computer-controlled player in the Battleship game. The machine uses a configurable ShotStrategy to determine which cell to target on each turn. Different strategies can be assigned without modifying the machine's behavior, following the Strategy design pattern.

    • chooseNextShot

      public Cell chooseNextShot(Board enemyBoard)
      Selects the next target cell on the opponent's board. If no strategy is currently assigned, a SmartShotStrategy is created automatically.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the cell selected as the next target

    • notifyShotResult

      public void notifyShotResult(Board enemyBoard, Cell shotCell, ShotResult result)
      Notifies the current strategy about the result of the machine's most recent shot. The strategy is informed only when the shot produces a hit or sinks a ship, allowing it to adapt future decisions if necessary.
      Parameters:
      enemyBoard - the opponent's board
      shotCell - the cell that was targeted
      result - the outcome of the shot
